landing.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
landing.faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
landing.faq.q1.a: LFA is designed for training companies that educate FIAE trainees (IT specialist in application development). The platform serves both trainers and trainees and supports the full training process — from learning management to exam preparation.
landing.faq.q2.q: What is the difference between Light and Pro?
landing.faq.q2.a: Light does not include learning content directly in the platform; it only provides source references (book title + page number). Trainees learn with their own textbooks. Pro includes extensive, IHK-compliant learning content directly in LFA — exam-oriented, thematically structured, and without external books.
landing.faq.q3.a: Enterprise is built for larger companies with specific requirements: full white-label option, SSO/SAML integration for single sign-on, custom corporate branding, unlimited company knowledge base, dedicated account manager, plus SLA and priority support.
landing.faq.q4.a: Yes. All data is stored exclusively on EU servers. LFA is developed according to GDPR requirements and continuously reviewed for data protection compliance. No data is shared with third parties.
landing.faq.q5.q: Can I try LFA before deciding?
landing.faq.q5.a: Yes — click "Watch demo" for a preview. For a complete test environment, contact us via the form. We are happy to set up a pilot instance for you.
landing.footer.description: AI-powered platform for dual IT training. Built by WAMOCON GmbH.
landing.solution.card1.title: Automated Documentation
landing.solution.card1.desc: Report books, certificates, and records are generated automatically. Trainers can focus on real mentoring instead of forms.
landing.solution.card2.title: Practical AI Learning
landing.solution.card2.desc: Practice-oriented scenarios, use cases, and quizzes are created from IHK-compliant content. Learning becomes concrete instead of abstract.
landing.solution.card3.title: Clear Training Path
landing.solution.card3.desc: Progress, calendar, deadlines, and goals in one place. Trainees can organize their apprenticeship from day one.
landing.solution.benefit1.title: Lower Dropout Rate
landing.solution.benefit1.desc: Guided trainees stay longer. Structured feedback keeps motivation high.
landing.solution.benefit2.title: Less Admin Effort
landing.solution.benefit2.desc: Report books, work certificates, and reports generated automatically.
landing.solution.benefit3.title: Higher Training Quality
landing.solution.benefit3.desc: IHK-compliant content improves final exam pass rates.
landing.why.subtitle: Not feature bingo, but real differentiators.
landing.why.card1.title: Closed-Context AI
landing.why.card1.desc: HAI answers only based on official IHK-compliant content. No hallucinations, every answer includes sources.
landing.why.card2.title: First Platform of Its Kind
landing.why.card2.desc: The first platform in Germany combining trainers and trainees in a closed learning ecosystem.
landing.why.card3.title: Real Feedback
landing.why.card3.desc: Your trainer reviews each submitted task personally and gives feedback tailored to your level.
landing.why.card4.title: Scenarios Instead of Textbook
landing.why.card4.desc: Practical scenarios, use cases, and adaptive quizzes are built from official IHK content.
landing.why.card5.title: Your Knowledge. Your Mentor.
landing.why.card5.desc: Companies upload their own documentation, coding standards, and processes. The AI learns with them.
landing.why.card6.title: Everything in One Place
landing.why.card6.desc: LMS, report book, work certificates, AI assistant, and performance evaluation. One platform instead of ten tools.
landing.roles.title: Two roles. One platform.
landing.roles.subtitle: What changes with LFA in practice — for trainers and trainees.
landing.roles.trainer.title: For Trainers
landing.roles.trainer.row1.before: Progress tracked in Excel sheets or not documented at all
landing.roles.trainer.row1.after: All trainees at a glance — dashboard shows real-time progress
landing.roles.trainer.row2.before: Report books, records, and certificates created manually
landing.roles.trainer.row2.after: Automated documents at the press of a button
landing.roles.trainer.row3.before: Sporadic feedback, often too late or too generic
landing.roles.trainer.row3.after: Targeted feedback directly in the platform
landing.roles.trainer.row4.before: Research and maintain IHK regulations manually
landing.roles.trainer.row4.after: IHK-compliant from day one — based on official FIAusbV
landing.roles.trainee.title: For Trainees
landing.roles.trainee.row1.before: No clear view of progress or next steps
landing.roles.trainee.row1.after: Clear structure — progress, tasks, and goals always visible
landing.roles.trainee.row2.before: Manage exam dates and deadlines manually, often forgotten
landing.roles.trainee.row2.after: Calendar with IHK exams, school blocks, and due dates
landing.roles.trainee.row3.before: Dry textbook theory without practical context
landing.roles.trainee.row3.after: Scenarios, use cases, and quizzes — all preparing for the exam
landing.roles.trainee.row4.before: Google searches for technical questions, conflicting answers
landing.roles.trainee.row4.after: HAI AI assistant with verified IHK-based answers
